# TurboTutor

> One-to-one Math, English and Science tutoring for Grades 1-8, online via Zoom or in person at Twin Hickory Library in Henrico County, Virginia. Weekly sessions start at $24. No online payment is collected.

## Pages

- [Home](https://turbotutor.dpdns.org/): plans, special coaching, welcome offers, session walkthrough, policies, FAQ and contact.
- [About the tutor](https://turbotutor.dpdns.org/about.html): who runs TurboTutor and how one-to-one sessions work.
- [Privacy policy](https://turbotutor.dpdns.org/privacy.html): what a request contains, browser storage, children's data and privacy rights.
- [Terms and conditions](https://turbotutor.dpdns.org/terms.html): requests, pricing, payment, attendance, liability and Virginia law.
- [Cookie policy](https://turbotutor.dpdns.org/cookies.html): no cookies are set; the two functional browser-storage keys and how to clear them.
- [Refund and cancellation policy](https://turbotutor.dpdns.org/refunds.html): tutor and family cancellations, unused sessions and how to request a refund.
- [Photo credits](https://turbotutor.dpdns.org/credits.html): sources and licences for the real Formula 1 and kart photographs.

## Key facts

- Grades 1-8, in Math, English or Science.
- 30, 45 and 60 minute sessions.
- Weekly, monthly and yearly plans. Monthly saves 5 percent; yearly saves 15 percent.
- Online on Zoom, or in person at Twin Hickory Library, Glen Allen, Virginia.
- Weekly 45-minute Zoom sessions start at $24. Math adds $3, English adds $5, and a library session adds $10.
- Moody IB Prep is $120 for one 120-minute Zoom session.
- High School Application Review is $35 per application, with an optional 90-minute Zoom meeting for $40 more.
- No card fields, checkout or payment processor. Cash or Zelle is arranged directly with the tutor after confirmation.
- A missed session carries a $15 fee; a family-requested reschedule carries a $10 fee; a tutor reschedule earns a 15 percent credit.

## Notes

- Prices shown on the site are suggested rates. The tutor confirms availability, schedule and the final amount in writing before enrollment.
- Requests are prepared in the browser and sent by the visitor from their own email or messaging app.
- The site has no analytics, advertising pixels or online payment. It sets no cookies and loads no third-party fonts or embeds; two functional browser-storage keys remember the theme and a welcome offer.
- Legal pages: Privacy, Terms, Cookies and Refunds, all effective 7 November 2026.
- Testimonials, ratings and a team photograph are not published because they do not exist yet.
